mainEntity.name: Do I need a college degree?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Qualifying education plus the PTIN, bond, background check and CTEC registration are the requirements.

mainEntity.name: How long does the 60-hour course take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Self-paced courses are commonly finished in a few weeks of part-time study. There is no minimum number of days, but providers set an access period.

mainEntity.name: Can I prepare returns while I wait for approval?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You may not prepare California returns for a fee until your CTEC registration is active.

mainEntity.name: Is the course available in Spanish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some providers offer Spanish-language courses. Filter for it in the provider directory.

mainEntity.name: How long is my course completion valid?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must register with CTEC within 18 months of completing your qualifying education.
